hypothesis: At least one fixed crypto spot strategy family retains positive out-of-sample net expectancy across BTC-USD and ETH-USD after conservative execution costs.
null_hypothesis: Any apparent gross edge disappears after costs or is isolated to one asset, activity regime, or fragile assumption.

data.source: Coinbase Exchange public REST product candles

families.mean_reversion: enter below -1.5 rolling 48-candle z-score; exit at zero
families.breakout: enter above prior 48-candle high with above-median quote volume; exit below prior 24-candle low

bias_controls: Signals formed at close execute no earlier than next candle open
First 60 percent fixes activity thresholds; last 40 percent is reported out of sample

execution_model.cost_scope: fee, half-spread and slippage scenario bound

promotion_gate: At the primary 20 bps per-side cost, a family must have positive out-of-sample net return on both products, avoid dependence on weekend or quiet activity alone, and remain positive at 40 bps per side on at least one product. Otherwise reject it from shadow promotion.
limitations_known_in_advance: Candles do not contain historical spread, depth, queue position, or exact venue fee tier
Cost scenarios bound rather than reconstruct those missing variables
Two products and sixty days cannot establish durable edge
The replay can reject weak ideas but cannot authorize capital
